prompt: In many communities, local charities and clubs are finding it increasingly difficult to recruit volunteers. Why is this happening? What could be done to encourage more people to give their time?
essay:
Nowadays, many local charities and clubs cannot find enough volunteers to help them. In the past, a lot of people were doing the voluntary work in their free time, but today it is not so common. This essay will discuss the reasons of this situation and some solutions to it.

There are several reasons why people do not volunteer anymore. Firstly, people are more busy than before. Most of the adults are working full time and many of them have long working hours, so when they come home they are too tired to help others. Secondly, the young generation is more interested in the social media and the computer games than helping in their community. Thirdly, people move to other cities very often for the job, so they do not feel that the local area is their home and they do not want to spend time for it.

However, there are some ways to encourage more people to volunteer. First of all, the government can give some reward to volunteers, for example a certificate or a discount on the public transport. This will motivate them to join. In addition, the schools should teach the students about the importance of helping others, and they can make the volunteering a part of the school programme. Also, the charities can use social media to advertise their activities, because this is the best way to reach the young people.

In conclusion, people do not volunteer because they are busy, they prefer the technology and they move often. The government, schools and charities should work together to solve this problem, so that the local communities can become strong again.
title: Why local charities struggle to find volunteers
